rules: Leadership replacement is not necessarily government replacement.
Government replacement/reform preserves civilization_id and appends history.
A transition requires a lawful process, political process, crisis, coercive event or other explicit causal chain.
Government form is not derived from species or culture stereotypes.
Political change can occur off-screen, but major transitions must materialize an event record.
A new government does not inherit planet-wide external recognition beyond its actual jurisdiction/recognition.
